{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01SXwQEFux5djaunPcCmFEHX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015qb1PeWQJ5Q9cX49p2z5Jt","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport asyncio, signal, os, threading, time\nfrom run import run_tasks\n\n# Test 1: basic concurrency\nasync def test_basic():\n    started = []\n    finished = []\n    in_flight = 0\n    max_in_flight = 0\n    lock = asyncio.Lock()\n\n    def make(i):\n        async def t():\n            nonlocal in_flight, max_in_flight\n            async with lock:\n                in_flight += 1\n                max_in_flight = max(max_in_flight, in_flight)\n            started.append(i)\n            await asyncio.sleep(0.05)\n            finished.append(i)\n            async with lock:\n                in_flight -= 1\n        return t\n\n    await run_tasks([make(i) for i in range(10)], max_concurrent=3)\n    assert sorted(finished) == list(range(10)), finished\n    assert max_in_flight == 3, max_in_flight\n    print('basic OK, max concurrent =', max_in_flight)\n\nasyncio.run(test_basic())\n\"\n","description":"Test basic concurrency behavior"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7414,"cache_read_input_tokens":23506,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":7414,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1b8973bc-ebea-42f6-ad87-334e3d8b7c11","uuid":"571f725e-d41b-4f42-aa7c-13cd758361a6","request_id":"req_011CbARttc3jwLqeeU51k7HT"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01DNSdmgV71qigm3VmKEwmSR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012gkV7WeFEBnHu5nGU5Jbh1","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/test_kbi.py << 'EOF'\nimport asyncio, signal, os, threading, time\nfrom run import run_tasks\n\ncleanup_log = []\n\ndef make(name, sleep_for):\n    async def t():\n        try:\n            await asyncio.sleep(sleep_for)\n            cleanup_log.append(f\"{name}-finished\")\n        except asyncio.CancelledError:\n            cleanup_log.append(f\"{name}-cancelled\")\n            # Simulate async cleanup; shield so it survives cancellation\n            await asyncio.shield(asyncio.sleep(0.1))\n            cleanup_log.append(f\"{name}-cleanup-done\")\n            raise\n    return t\n\nasync def main():\n    # Schedule a SIGINT after 0.2s\n    def fire():\n        time.sleep(0.2)\n        os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGINT)\n    threading.Thread(target=fire, daemon=True).start()\n    try:\n        await run_tasks([make(f\"t{i}\", 5) for i in range(4)], max_concurrent=2)\n    except (asyncio.CancelledError, KeyboardInterrupt):\n        pass\n\ntry:\n    asyncio.run(main())\nexcept KeyboardInterrupt:\n    pass\n\nprint(\"log:\", cleanup_log)\n# We expect that for any tasks that started, both -cancelled and -cleanup-done were recorded\nstarted = {x.split(\"-\")[0] for x in cleanup_log if x.endswith(\"-cancelled\")}\ncleaned = {x.split(\"-\")[0] for x in cleanup_log if x.endswith(\"-cleanup-done\")}\nprint(\"started tasks that got cancelled:\", started)\nprint(\"cleanup completed for:\", cleaned)\nassert started == cleaned, f\"cleanup did not run for all cancelled tasks: started={started} cleaned={cleaned}\"\nprint(\"KBI cleanup OK\")\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/test_kbi.py","description":"Test cleanup runs after SIGINT"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":482,"cache_read_input_tokens":30920,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":482,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":70,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1b8973bc-ebea-42f6-ad87-334e3d8b7c11","uuid":"ffefdd66-9ca4-4359-a067-4fbd5dfe6222","request_id":"req_011CbARuR8LZH7pMNEpewdsz"}
